First, we write the integral as

$$
{\int }_{1}^{{e}^{3}}{log}_{5}⁡({x}^{3})\,\text{d}x={\int }_{1}^{{e}^{3}}{log}_{5}⁡({x}^{3})\cdot 1\cdot \text{d}x.
$$

 

We will solve this problem using integration by parts. We start by defining $u$ and ${v}^{′},$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}u={log}_{5}⁡({x}^{3})\, & ⟹\,{u}^{′}=\frac{3}{x\operatorname{ln}⁡(5)} \\ {v}^{′}=1\, & ⟹\,v=\int 1\cdot \,dx=x\end{aligned}
$$

Using the formula of integration by parts, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1}^{{e}^{3}}{log}_{5}⁡({x}^{3})\,\text{d}x & ={\int }_{1}^{{e}^{3}}u{v}^{′}\text{d}x \\  & =uv{|}_{1}^{{e}^{3}}-{\int }_{1}^{{e}^{3}}v{u}^{′}\text{d}x \\  & ={log}_{5}⁡({x}^{3})\,(x){|}_{1}^{{e}^{3}}-{\int }_{1}^{{e}^{3}}x(\frac{3}{x\operatorname{ln}⁡(5)})\,\text{d}x \\  & =[{log}_{5}⁡(({e}^{3})^{3})\,({e}^{3})-{log}_{5}⁡({1}^{3})\,(1)]-\frac{3}{\operatorname{ln}⁡(5)}{\int }_{1}^{{e}^{3}}\text{d}x \\  & ={e}^{3}{log}_{5}⁡({e}^{9})-\frac{3}{\operatorname{ln}⁡(5)}x{|}_{1}^{{e}^{3}} \\  & ={e}^{3}\cdot \frac{9}{\operatorname{ln}⁡(5)}-\frac{3}{\operatorname{ln}⁡(5)}({e}^{3}-1) \\  & =\frac{6{e}^{3}+3}{\operatorname{ln}⁡(5)}.\end{aligned}
$$
